{{Top|leg}}
A '''datalog''' was an electronic publication that featured merchandise for sale. ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]'' was a datalog that, as it name suggested, sold technological items across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Individual pages of a datalog were known as '''datapages.'''
